    "testCaseID": "TC001",
    "title": "TCS AGENTIC - Positive Testing: Successful LTE Attach and Detach for Multiple UEs",
    "description": "Validate successful attach and detach procedures for multiple UEs in LTE mode under excellent radio conditions.",
    "preconditions": [
      "Set up single cell LTE network with excellent radio conditions as per Clause 4.6.",
      "Multiple (at least 2) real or emulated UEs are powered off and ready for test.",
      "All other cells except serving cell are powered off."
    ],
    "testSteps": [
      "Configure test setup according to test configuration and record parameters.",
      "Start logging to capture call flow and signaling messages.",
      "Power ON all UEs simultaneously to trigger LTE attach procedures.",
      "Wait for successful attach of all UEs, verifying attach request and attach complete messages per 3GPP TS 23.401 Clause 5.3.2.1.",
      "Verify each UE is attached to the correct cell (PCI, Global eNB ID, ARFCN) via UE logs or applications.",
      "Power OFF all UEs simultaneously to trigger LTE detach procedures.",
      "Wait for successful detach of all UEs, verifying detach request and detach accept messages per 3GPP TS 23.401 Clause 5.3.8.2.1.",
      "Stop and save logs for analysis.",
      "Repeat steps 3 to 8 for a total of 10 iterations.",
      "Calculate and record attach success rate, detach success rate, and attach latency metrics in test report as per Table 5-4 and Table 5-5."
    ],
    "expectedResults": [
      "Attach success rate and detach success rate for all UEs is 100% for all 10 iterations.",
      "Attach latency values (min, average, max) are within acceptable ranges as defined in test configuration.",
      "UEs are correctly attached to the intended LTE cell with correct cell parameters.",
      "No connectivity issues or errors during attach or detach procedures."
    ],
    "postconditions": [
      "All UEs remain in detached state after test completion.",
      "Test logs are securely saved for review."
    ],
    "commandsUsed": [],
    "verificationMethods": [
      "Review of UE logs for attach/detach message flow and cell identification parameters.",
      "Analysis of captured signaling logs for validation of attach and detach procedures.",
      "Measurement of latency timestamps between Attach Request and Attach Complete."
    ]
  },
